tasks.title: Extract per-section context, screenshots and every asset in one pass
tasks.interface: For each of the 14 whitelisted node ids in tasks.json figma.sections (7 desktop + 7 mobile): call get_design_context and save the raw output verbatim to design/raw/<nodeId>.md; call get_screenshot and curl the returned image_url to design/ref/<nodeId>.png at 1x (maxDimension 1440 for desktop, 393 for mobile); then immediately download every asset URL found in that section's context to public/assets/<sha256>.<ext> and append a record to public/assets/manifest.json before moving on. Asset URLs are short-lived (~7 days) — download in the same pass, never later. NEVER call any tool on 2655:706, 2655:707 or 2665:311. If a section's get_design_context returns an SSE JSON parse error (~32 KB limit; 2655:708 at 102 nodes and 2665:459 at 157 nodes are the likely offenders), call get_metadata on that SECTION id, then get_design_context per direct child frame, and stitch the results into the section .md. Never retry the failing call unchanged. Inline <svg> in the context is saved verbatim as .svg. manifest.json record shape: { nodeIds: string[], section: string, kind: 'image'|'vector', localPath: string, width: number, height: number, sha256: string, alt: string } where alt is '' for decorative art and a real description for content photos. design/sections.json shape: { id, desktopNodeId, mobileNodeId, desktopHeight, mobileHeight, copy, paddings, columnWidths, typography, gradients, assets, faqInitialOpen, mixedSizeSpans }. Record in sections.json which FAQ item is drawn open (the height gate depends on it) and the hero headline's mixed-size spans. Override both stale mobile headings with desktop copy: habits -> 'Build Better Financial Habits With Soniq', faq -> 'Questions About Managing Money With Soniq?'. scripts/check-design.mjs asserts: exactly 14 raw files present, none of the 3 forbidden ids appear anywhere in design/, each raw context's root frame size matches the tasks.json table, each design/ref PNG is a valid PNG, and both stale headings are overridden. scripts/check-assets.mjs asserts: every image/vector node id in sections.json maps to an existing non-empty file whose sha256 matches, no manifest localPath points off-disk, no figma.com URL survives in src/ or public/; and PRINTS (does not fail on) every raster whose pixel width is below 2x its largest rendered width. Add scripts verify:design and verify:assets to package.json. Commit design/raw/, design/ref/, design/sections.json, public/assets/ and the manifest as an explicit step in this task.
tasks.verify: npm run verify:design && npm run verify:assets && test $(ls design/raw/*.md | wc -l) -eq 14 && test $(ls design/ref/*.png | wc -l) -eq 14 && ! grep -rq '2665:311' design/ && ! grep -rq 'api/mcp/asset' src/ public/assets/manifest.json && git status --porcelain design public | wc -l | grep -q '^0$'

tasks.title: Token layer, sections.ts, page shell with seven stub sections
tasks.interface: globals.css follows the house pattern: '@import "tailwindcss";' then :root custom properties, then '@theme inline' mapping them to Tailwind utilities, then .ds-* classes. Colour tokens — ink: #000000, #141507 (page canvas), #25251d, #373737, #5f5f5f, #727272. light: #ffffff, #fffff5 (absorbs #f5f6ee), #f7f7f7, #f0f2e7, #e6e9d7. lime: #b0f10e (absorbs #b5fa08), #9ddd39, #9fab26. neutral: #bbbcb3, #d9d9d9, #595959, #585a62. Six linear gradients from sections.json. PLUS --color-lime-text-on-light: a darkened lime measured at >= 4.5:1 against BOTH #ffffff and #fffff5, used ONLY for lime text on light surfaces. Verified facts: #b0f10e on white is 1.36:1 and #9ddd39/#9fab26 are 2.52:1 or worse, so no palette lime is usable as text on light — do not substitute another palette lime. Radius tokens: 12, 20, 24, 90, pill(9999). Radius 90 is first-class (21 uses, large cards) — never fold it into pill. Snap drift: 11->12, 12.5->12, 23->24, 190.5->pill. Type tokens from sections.json typography, folding stray Manrope and Inter Variable into Satoshi/Inter Tight. Layout switch: mobile comp structure below 768px, desktop comp at and above; sizes differing between comps use clamp(<m>px, calc(<m>px + (<d> - <m>) * (100vw - 393px) / 1047), <d>px) so 393 and 1440 land exactly on comp values. src/lib/sections.ts is generated from design/sections.json and is the SINGLE source of truth for heights; it exports SECTIONS (id, desktopNodeId, mobileNodeId, desktopHeight, mobileHeight), PAGE_HEIGHT and a SectionId type, and asserts at module load that the per-section heights sum to PAGE_HEIGHT (desktop 7789, mobile 8471 — verified correct). page.tsx renders a skip link, then all seven sections in order, each as <section id={id} data-section={id}>; stubs render only a heading. THIS TASK OWNS page.tsx — section tasks T6..T10 must never edit it. Styling in section components is Tailwind utilities plus <Name>.module.css; NO global per-section .css files (silent order-dependent class collisions, and @apply outside globals.css needs @reference in Tailwind v4). Button: variant 'lime'|'dark'|'ghost'; renders <a> only for real in-page anchors, otherwise <button type="button"> — never href="#", which jumps the viewport to the top.
tasks.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && node -e "const c=require('fs').readFileSync('src/app/globals.css','utf8');for(const t of ['--color-lime-text-on-light','--radius-90'])if(!c.includes(t))throw new Error('missing token '+t);if(/hero\.css|pricing\.css/.test(require('fs').readdirSync('src/components/sections').join()))throw new Error('global per-section css found');console.log('T4 ok')" && grep -c 'data-section' src/components/sections/*.tsx | wc -l | grep -q '^7$'

tasks.title: measure.mjs height and overflow harness, with self-test
tasks.interface: scripts/measure.mjs uses Playwright + Chromium ONLY — no axe, no Lighthouse (those are page-level and belong in T11). Add @playwright/test as a devDependency; 'npx playwright install chromium' is part of this task. Reads src/lib/sections.ts (or design/sections.json) for the height table. Flags: --section | --all; --overflow-only (skip height deltas, for use against stubs); --url (point at an already-running server instead of spawning one). Default behaviour: PORT PREFLIGHT first — if 3017 is already listening, exit nonzero with 'port 3017 occupied by a server this script did not start' rather than measuring it (connecting to a stale server is how a false pass happens); then spawn 'npm run start', wait for readiness by polling the port, measure, and kill ONLY its own process tree. Asserts, for each requested section: rendered height of [data-section=] within +/-2% of the table value at viewport 1440x900 and at 393x852, measured only after 'document.fonts.ready' resolves and all have decoded; document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth at 320, 393, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920; zero console errors during load. Prints a per-section table of measured height, expected height and delta percent, then exits nonzero on any breach. Self-test: scripts/fixtures/stub-pass.html contains fixed-height divs with the exact data-section ids and heights from the table and MUST pass with --url; stub-fail.html is empty and MUST fail with a per-section report. If Chromium is missing, fail immediately with an actionable install message rather than a stack trace.
tasks.verify: npx playwright install chromium && node scripts/measure.mjs --url "file://$(pwd)/scripts/fixtures/stub-pass.html" --all && ( node scripts/measure.mjs --url "file://$(pwd)/scripts/fixtures/stub-fail.html" --all ; test $? -ne 0 ) && echo 'T5 ok: harness passes on stub-pass and fails on stub-fail'

THIS IS THE CALIBRATION TASK: build the hero from the extracted spec WITHOUT pre-tuning, then run the gate. Inter Tight is not metrically identical to Helvetica Neue, so a first-try miss is expected. Fix any drift in the TOKEN LAYER (globals.css: font size-adjust, letter-spacing, line-height) so every later section inherits the correction, never by patching the hero alone. Record the measured heights at 1440 and 393 and the final delta percentages in PLAN.md under 'Open risks / R1'. tasks.title: Consolidated gate — axe, Lighthouse, network, console, visual overlay
tasks.interface:
Prerequisite: 'node scripts/measure.mjs --all' is green. playwright.config.ts uses webServer { command: 'npm run start', url: 'http://localhost:3017', reuseExistingServer: false } so the suite can never bind to a stale server and report a false pass. tests/landing.spec.ts asserts: the seven data-section ids appear in document order; every section and the page total within +/-2% at 1440 and 393 in the documented FAQ state, measured after document.fonts.ready and image decode; scrollWidth <= innerWidth at 320/393/768/1024/1440/1920; every has an alt attribute; exactly one

and no heading-level jumps greater than 1; every image, svg and font request is same-origin with zero requests whose host matches figma.com, fontshare, googleapis or gstatic; font preload links present; zero console errors. tests/a11y.spec.ts runs @axe-core/playwright with wcag2a and wcag2aa at both viewports expecting zero violations (color-contrast is the known risk — the lime-on-light token exists for exactly this), and drives the FAQ by keyboard: Tab to the first question, Enter toggles aria-expanded to 'true' and reveals the aria-controls region, Space toggles it back; a separate case opens every item and asserts the page grows without clipping. scripts/lighthouse.mjs runs TWICE with EXPLICIT screenEmulation — { width: 393, height: 852, mobile: true, deviceScaleFactor: 3 } and { width: 1440, height: 900, mobile: false, deviceScaleFactor: 1 } — because Lighthouse defaults to 412x823 and 1350x940 and would audit neither designed width; asserts accessibility >= 95 and CLS < 0.1; writes reports/ (gitignored). scripts/overlay.mjs renders each built section at 1440 and writes a side-by-side against the committed design/ref/.png into scripts/out/ (gitignored) for the visual-fidelity judgement. Record final measured per-section deltas and every deviation from the comp in PLAN.md.
tasks.verify: npx playwright install chromium && npm run build && npm run lint && node scripts/measure.mjs --all && npx playwright test && node scripts/lighthouse.mjs && node scripts/overlay.mjs && git status --porcelain reports scripts/out | wc -l | grep -q '^0$'
